text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Now then, that's all for reviewing today's lessons.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... There's still time until training,
so I could probably read through one technical book.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
(They say not to overdo it, but still...
If I'm gonna be number one, this much is only natural!)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Now that that's decided, what should I read?
Thinking about the next race...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I really got absorbed in reading.
I felt like I was right on the verge of grasping something, but time is—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Wait, it's been a whole hour already!?
Training's already started...! B-But――

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, just a few more pages!
I feel like I'm on the verge of figuring it out... so it's fine, right?"

I was so consumed by the desire to be number one
that I ended up neglecting my training...
